### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **54** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **15** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/spec-changes.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**50** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **15** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/spec-changes.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `created_at (literal, 38 pages)`, `objectName (literal, 38 pages)`
- **16** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `714d8f2c2d2291474fa96f3adbbad797b1b86686` — the merge of head `5faf12295faaf4d53d2d9d797e90470685084e67` into base `76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 714d8f2c2d2291474fa96f3adbbad797b1b86686 && git checkout 714d8f2c2d2291474fa96f3adbbad797b1b86686
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb 5faf12295faaf4d53d2d9d797e90470685084e67 && git checkout -B drift-repro 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb && git merge --no-ff 5faf12295faaf4d53d2d9d797e90470685084e67

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 76bc1e03a3237150934a35370406a5ddd7cde4fb` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

`domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-sales` · session `session_01DhTqaEHqPVSVnAkjG3jywn` · 2026-10-10T05:21Z。This is the final version of the PR body's draft, corrected against the diff the seat read at `5faf12295` (ACCEPT `6094161139` on #11509).


### 改了什么

- 页面里的三个元素组件，不再接受直接写在 `properties` 里的数据绑定键：
  - 记录选择器 `element:record_picker`：`object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`；
  - 数字 `element:number`：`object` / `filter`；
  - 重复列表 `element:repeater`：`object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`。
- 作者改为写在组件节点的 `dataSource` 上，即 `dataSource.object`、`dataSource.filter`、`dataSource.sort`、`dataSource.limit`。repeater 原来的别名(`objectName`、`filters`、`where`、`orderBy`、`sortBy`、`top`、`pageSize`)也一并指向 `dataSource`。
- 对象表格 `object-grid` 的 `defaultFilters` 不再接受，规则改写到 `filter`。
- 旧写法在校验和保存时会被拒绝，错误信息里直接给出新写法。`os validate` 对缺少 `dataSource.object` 的这三个元素给出警告。
- 已有元数据可以用 `os migrate meta --from 17` 自动改写。改写不了的情况会留一条 TODO 提示作者手工处理：两种写法取值不同，或者 `dataSource` 指向了一个已保存的视图。
- Studio 的页面设计器在新的控制台 pin(`.objectui-sha` = `20c6d351a`)上，已经按新形状写这三个元素。repeater 的“对象”和“条数”两栏写入 `dataSource`，作者在 Studio 里拖出来的组件不会被拒绝。

### 为什么改

- 同一个查询原来有两个入口(`properties` 和 `dataSource`)，三个组件各自用不同规则合并两边，作者写下的值不一定生效。
- repeater 还有一个陷阱：只写 `dataSource` 时，`os validate` 显示通过，页面却显示“No records”。
- 裁决 A-narrow(`6051498447`)定为：只保留 `dataSource` 一个入口，先让 objectui 读写新形状，再在 spec 里收回旧键。这一步现在已经具备条件。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- **破坏性变更。** 属于 v18 大版本：`@objectstack/spec` 与 `@objectstack/lint` 带 major changeset。没有跑迁移的旧元数据会在校验时报错。
- **宿主 pin 规则。** 同时 pin 两个仓库的宿主，要先移动 objectui 的 pin，越过 objectui#11880，才能读迁移后的形状；之后才能把 objectstack 的 pin 移过本次退役。Studio 设计器按新形状写 repeater，要从 objectui#12056 起；当前控制台 pin `20c6d351a` 两者都已包含。
- **已知遗留(不在本 PR 内)。**
  - html 类型页面里，`os validate` 仍要求 `element:repeater` 标签写平铺的 `object`，并拒绝只写 `dataSource` 的写法。原因在 objectui 的组件注册清单，已立卡 objectstack-ai/objectui#12085。
  - objectui 自己的部分测试在升级到 spec 18 时，需要改用新写法。
- **体量。** 4310 行变更，超过 3000 行人工合并线。
- **回滚。** 直接 revert 本 PR 的合并提交即可。已经迁移成 `dataSource` / `filter` 的元数据，在旧版本里本来就是合法写法，回滚后不需要再迁移回去。

### 席位意见

- **建议合并。** 席位复核了本轮的 diff 和读数：合并 `main` 只有一处生成账本冲突，已按两边各自的增减算清；`Check Changeset` 那次报红的根因已经找到并修好，没有挂标签，也没有改版本级别；最新 head `5faf12295` 上 CI 全绿。
- **合并前还欠一份契约复审。** 按你的话「契约复审交给总监」，由总监席在 `5faf12295` 上做。复审通过后再合并。
- **它挡住的卡：** #22444 在等本 PR 落地。

### 你要做的(一个动作)

审阅并亲手合并 PR #22421。
